---
title: "Transparency"
description: "How we report AI use in manuscripts, figures, code, and teaching."
---

AI tools now play a part in writing manuscripts, making figures, writing code, and preparing teaching material. Readers, reviewers, and students deserve to know when and how.

## Open questions

- What level of detail should an AI disclosure contain?
- Should the prompts, tool names, and versions be archived with the data, as the DMP does for software?
- How do we disclose AI use in code and analysis scripts?
- What should students be told about AI use in teaching material?
